scripts.check:ai: pnpm --filter ai-service lint && pnpm --filter ai-service typecheck && pnpm --filter ai-service test
scripts.check:backend: cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run pytest -q
scripts.check:backoffice: pnpm --filter backoffice exec biome ci . && pnpm --filter backoffice exec tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --noEmit && pnpm --filter backoffice test:ai
scripts.check:portal: pnpm --filter portal exec biome ci . && pnpm --filter portal exec tsc --noEmit
